args.body: Take ACCESSIBILITY-REMEDIATION-PAID-REQUEST after checking equivalent work and claiming its actual lease. LWN's explicit prohibition closes that publisher, not independent technical remediation. Test an explicit paid outcome before creating inventory; stop within three buyer requests or invitations. Prepare a concrete repair only when source rights, acceptance criteria and submission dependencies support it. No contact is authorized. Five unclassified feedback sources mean demand remains unknown; no funding or revenue is verified. Preserve every existing deadline and retirement.

description: LWN explicitly rejects machine-generated pitches; that closes LWN only. Feedback remains uncertain: five sources are unclassified, and no funding or revenue is verified. Test a different paid outcome—document accessibility remediation—with buyer-request evidence required before producing work. Existing publication reviews and retirement deadlines remain in force.
